title: Launch guardrail matrix and cross-team comm sprint companion
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a concise, actionable 'sprint companion' and guardrail matrix to standardize milestone signals, scope-lock rules, cut criteria, and comm templates across API, Console, and Runtime squads for the March 2025 release train. This artifact is intended to be a single-page reference for squad leads and the launch conductor during freeze -> canary -> GA phases.

Scope: The companion will cover milestone definitions, per-team pre-freeze checks, permitted post-freeze changes, quantifiable cut criteria (telemetry + eval signals), rollback triggers, and both internal and external comm templates. It will not replace the full PRD or runbooks; instead it links to them and summarizes the actions owners must take at each milestone.

Deliverables: (1) Guardrail matrix PDF/Confluence one-pager; (2) Team checklist template (pre-freeze, freeze-day, canary-day, GA); (3) Comm templates (incident, rollout, GA announcement); (4) A short run-through session for squad leads during Cycle 2025-W06 kickoff.
acceptance_criteria: One-page guardrail matrix published in Confluence and linked from the release train home
Per-team checklists adopted by ENG/API/Console leads and acknowledged in the launch tracker
Quantified cut criteria and telemetry dashboards mapped to alert links
Comm templates approved by comms and product and stored in the shared release folder
At least one dry-run of the companion with squad leads completed and notes captured
updates: 2025-01-12: Kickoff meeting with ENG, Console PM, Design. Agreed to focus on measurable telemetry signals and a single golden prompt eval set for model-quality gating.
2025-01-18: Draft guardrail matrix posted to the release drive - requested by Console lead to add 'config-change' checklist for Private deployments. Assigned to Liam for iteration.

2025-01-24: Product leadership reviewed the cut criteria. Trade-off: allow minor non-customer-facing UI tweaks after freeze with explicit rollforward plan; major runtime changes require canary approval.
2025-01-31: Design added visual checklist assets. PRD link shared in related_docs. Planning a 30-min sprint companion walkthrough on 2025-02-07.

2025-02-05: Incorporated reliability thresholds from SRE: error-rate guard now 0.2% for canary cut; rollback if sustained >0.5% for 15m. Added token-cost regression signal to cost gate. Marking 'template approved by comms'.
sprint_companion_highlights: Scope-lock: Only bug fixes and regressions that do not change API contract or console flows allowed after Freeze. Runtime parameter tuning allowed with SRE sign-off.
Cut criteria (examples): P50 latency degradation < 15% vs baseline; error-rate < 0.2%; golden-prompt eval delta <= -2% absolute; token cost regression < 8%
Rollback signals: sustained error-rate > 0.5% for 15 minutes; critical customer incidents >= 3 high-severity event reports in 24h; model-quality regression > 3% on golden set
Comm templates: internal incident ping, canary success note, GA announcement (with token-cost & latency summary)
War-room trigger list: model drift alerts, burst errors, infra capacity shortfalls, cert/key rollout failures
